result.guidanceOfficial: As we enter the final quarter of 2026, we continue to anticipate both sequential and year-over-year Base revenue improvement, inclusive of the fewer operating days typical for the fourth fiscal quarter, and expect to sustain this growth momentum into 2027. We remain steadfastly focused on cost management actions to mitigate the uneven 2026 sales cadence, while effectively addressing ongoing material cost pressures related to broad electronics supply chain dynamics.
